notes.title: Hyphen is now for Linux too!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the awesome FNA project we have ported Hyphen to Linux!

The game is pretty much exactly the same as the Windows counterpart minus a couple of tweaks we needed to do for graphical compatibility and audio.

Enjoy, and we're pleased to be on Linux!

notes.title: Death Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Hyphen now has a Deaths leaderboard (not in game just in the Steam client for the time being). Not many people are on it yet as it we've pushed an update and it requires you to launch the updated version of the game and die to get your deathcount on the leaderboard. It will be interesting to see how many deaths some people have had though!

[url]http://steamcommunity.com/stats/346510/leaderboards/705349[/url]

notes.title: Global Death counter!
notes.notes:
We've added a global death counter to the main Hyphen page on our website [url]http://www.farspacestudios.com/games/hyphen/[/url] just for kicks.

It shows how many times everyone who owns Hyphen on Steam combined has died in game in real time. It's at over 12k deaths already in the short time that Hyphen has been live!
